data.text: In the LORD I take refuge. How can you say to me, “Flee like a bird to your mountain”?
data.titulo: Refuge When Justice Seems to Fail
data.subtitulo: For the music leader. Of David.

data.text: For look, the wicked bend the bow; they set their arrow on the string to shoot from the darkness at the upright in heart.
When the foundations are torn down, what can the righteous do?
The LORD is in his holy temple; the LORD’s throne is in heaven. His eyes behold; his eyelids examine humankind.
The LORD tests the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and those who love violence.
He will rain snares upon the wicked; fire, sulfur, and a scorching wind will be the portion of their cup.
For the LORD is righteous; he loves righteous deeds. The upright will behold his face.
